title: Oprah Winfrey names book by Ontario-born author as her latest book club pick
summary: Previous Canadian books featured on Oprah’s Book Club include A Fine Balance by Rohinton Mistry and Fall on Your Knees by Ann-Marie Macdonald.

Oprah Winfrey’s new book club pick is an acclaimed Canadian author’s novel about a small community in the late 1960s that’s upended by a young American who has crossed the border to flee the Vietnam War draft.
Solace in Winter, which Winfrey praised as "beautifully written and deeply moving” in a statement, is the November pick for Oprah’s Book Club.
“Solace in Winter reminds us that even in our loneliest moments, unexpected connections can open our hearts, heal old wounds, and change our lives in ways we never imagined,” Winfrey said.

Solace in Winter is a novel set in the small town of Solace in the winter of 1969. It follows a widower named Jack whose quiet life is upended when he finds a dog in a bad way and an injured American draft dodger on the road near his place.
He takes them both in, but when his daughter comes to visit one day, she makes a decision that she can’t take back.

blocks.text: “I was knocked sideways when Oprah phoned. In fact, to begin with, I didn’t believe it was her. I thought it was a hoax and I nearly hung up. But then she mentioned Solace in Winter, which at that stage hadn’t yet been published, and I thought, just a minute," Lawson told CBC Books in a statement.
"As a writer I am thrilled, of course. As a Canadian, at this particular time, I think it can only be a good thing that a Canadian voice will be heard on the other side of the border. ”

Lawson is also the author of the novels A Town Called Solace, Crow Lake, The Other Side of the Bridge and Road Ends. A Town Called Solace and The Other Side of the Bridge were longlisted for the Booker Prize.
Lawson, currently based in England, is originally from the small farming community of Blackwell, near Sarnia, Ont.

blocks.text: Oprah's Book Club has been recommending titles since 1996 picked out by Winfrey herself. The book club began as a segment on the The Oprah Winfrey Show.

Previous Canadian books featured on Oprah’s Book Club include A Fine Balance by Rohinton Mistry, selected in November of 2001, and Fall on Your Knees by Ann-Marie Macdonald, selected in January of 2002.
